title: Services / Claude Bot
description: Whether the Discord bot answers the questions it gets, what limits it, who asks, and one log line per decision. Counts over the selected range, since the bot answers a handful of questions an hour.

links.title: Fleet overview
links.tooltip: Start page: every host, service and signal at a glance

list.name: Argo CD syncs
list.expr: (sum by (name, phase) (increase(argocd_app_sync_total{dry_run="false",name!~".+-mr-[0-9]+"}[2m])) > 0 unless on (name) sum by (name) (increase(argocd_app_sync_total{dry_run="false"}[1h])) > 6) and on () vector($syncs) > 0

list.name: Host rebuilds
list.expr: (max by (host_name, revision) (sysconf_installed_commit_time_seconds) unless max by (host_name, revision) (sysconf_installed_commit_time_seconds offset 15m)) and on () vector($rebuilds) > 0

list.name: user
list.label: User
list.description: Part of a Discord user id. Empty shows every user.

list.name: search
list.label: Search
list.description: Text that the event lines must contain, for example refused or a channel id.

list.name: syncs
list.label: Argo CD syncs
list.description: Marks each Argo CD sync on the time series.

list.name: rebuilds
list.label: Host rebuilds
list.description: Marks each NixOS rebuild on the time series.

panels.description: Questions asked over the selected range.
Share of the questions that got an answer. Empty when nobody asked.
Questions that a rate limit or the concurrency gate turned away.
Median time from question to answer.

panels.title: In flight and queued
panels.description: Questions the model works on, and questions waiting for a free slot.
Questions inside the rolling 24 hours against the ceiling that the bot reports (RATE_LIMIT_GLOBAL_PER_DAY).

panels.title: Questions per hour by outcome
panels.description: Questions in the trailing hour at each point.

panels.title: Refusals per hour by reason
panels.description: refused_user_bucket: one person asks too fast. refused_global_hour and refused_global_day: the whole server hit the ceiling. refused_queue: every slot busy and the queue full.

panels.title: Global budget against the ceiling
panels.description: Questions inside the rolling hour and day. The ceiling comes from the bot, so a ConfigMap change moves the line.

panels.title: In flight and queued
panels.description: Questions the model works on, and questions waiting for a slot.

panels.title: Answer time
panels.description: Time from question to answer over the selected range.

panels.title: Turns per question
panels.description: Model turns per question over the selected range. A question that takes more turns used a tool.

panels.title: Tool time p90
panels.description: 90th percentile duration per Discord tool over the selected range.

panels.title: Discord tool calls per hour
panels.description: Calls of the channel-reading tools. WebSearch and WebFetch run inside the Agent SDK and stay out. A high turn count with no tool call here means the model searched the web.

panels.title: Model tokens per hour
panels.description: Tokens per hour by kind. Cache reads dwarf the rest in a long conversation. Input and output count against the subscription.

panels.title: Askers
panels.description: Every user and channel with a question over the selected range, from the bot's decision log. Select a user to narrow the dashboard.

targets.expr: app:claude-bot outcome:* user_id:~"$user" | stats by (user_id, channel_id, surface) count() questions, count() if (outcome:=answered) answered, count() if (outcome:~"^refused") refused, quantile(0.5, duration_s) p50 | sort by (questions desc) | limit 100

panels.title: Tokens left per user
panels.description: Rate-limit tokens per user. The bucket refills over time, a drop marks a question. A user appears from the first question on.

panels.title: CPU by pod
panels.description: CPU cores in use per pod against its limit. At the limit the kernel throttles the pod. Each point averages 5 minutes.

panels.title: Memory by pod
panels.description: Working set per pod against its limit. A container that reaches the limit gets killed.

panels.title: Restarts by container
panels.description: Container restarts per interval. A restart of a single-replica service drops every open connection.

panels.title: Bot events
panels.description: One line per decision with the user, the outcome and the exact refusal, newest first. User and Search narrow it.

targets.expr: app:claude-bot user_id:~"$user" _msg:~"$search" | copy severity_text as level
